verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device inference SDK and engine, so the ability to load quantized models is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions FP8, INT4, GPTQ, AWQ or any other quantization format. It covers model downloads, NPU acceleration, kernel validation and a llama.cpp fallback, but none of that documents which quantized weight formats the product can load.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load models quantized in formats like FP8, INT4, GPTQ, or AWQ
